nodes.label: Oil became more expensive
nodes.subline: Supply fears increased the risk premium
nodes.source_sentence: Brent crude settled at $109.86, up 3.7% from Thursday.

popover.title: Why oil rose
popover.plain: War risk made each barrel more expensive.
popover.precise: Brent settled at $109.86, up from $105.92 Thursday. Oil affects gasoline, diesel, shipping, and production costs.

nodes.label: Investors may expect higher interest rates

popover.title: Interest-rate expectations
popover.plain: Investors may think the Federal Reserve will keep rates high longer.
popover.precise: Faster price growth can make investors expect higher interest rates. The Federal Open Market Committee sets a target range for the federal funds rate; expected changes can affect longer-term rates.

nodes.label: Higher rates can make future profits worth less

popover.title: Worth less today
popover.plain: Money expected later is worth less today when interest rates are higher.
popover.analogy: A savings account paying more makes waiting for money more attractive than paying as much for future profits now.
popover.precise: Present value discounts expected future cash flows at a market rate; a higher discount rate lowers what future profits are worth today, all else equal.

popover.title: Government borrowing rate
popover.plain: The government's 10-year borrowing rate was 5.09% at 4:10 PM ET.
popover.precise: The 10-year Treasury yield influences many longer-term borrowing rates. It slipped from 5.10% Thursday to 5.09% Friday.

popover.title: Technology-led decline
popover.plain: The Nasdaq index was down 2.1% at 4:10 PM ET.
popover.precise: The Nasdaq closed at 26,140.03, down 572.99 points. All but seven S&P 500 technology stocks ended lower.

nodes.label: Loans can cost more; some savings can earn more

popover.title: Illustration only
popover.plain: If this sample mortgage rate rose one point, the monthly bill would rise about $209.
popover.analogy: $300,000 borrowed for 30 years costs about $2,077 monthly at 7.40% and $2,286 at 8.40%.
popover.precise: Standard fixed-payment amortization with monthly compounding. Principal $300,000; 360 payments; Freddie Mac 30-year fixed rate 7.40% for the week of Oct. 8, 2026. Not a forecast; actual rates vary by lender and borrower.

caption_candidates.text: Also cited by The Associated Press: growth and government debt
caption_candidates.matched_excerpt: The U.S. economy is still growing, alongside longstanding worries about fast-rising government debt loads, sending yields higher.

caption_candidates.text: Also cited by The Associated Press: mixed financial-company earnings
caption_candidates.matched_excerpt: BlackRock rose after stronger results, while Bank of America and State Street fell after weaker results.

takeaway: Higher oil costs can keep loans expensive and pressure tech shares.
other_factors_note: Earnings, AI demand, and global news can also move markets.
